lede: The San Miguel County BOCC holds public hearings Tuesday on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to how 'Qualified Owner' is defined in the affordable housing code and a wildfire areas update — and those are the kinds of rewrites that quietly reshape what's possible here for years. Also Tuesday, Ouray County's Planning Commission meets virtually to work through possible changes to their own land use definitions, while Mountain Village's Design Review Board takes up three multifamily projects Thursday. On the lighter side, the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo kicks off Friday alongside the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet at the farmers market.

notable.stake: Board votes on officer elections and fiscal policy amendments with significant time allocated.
Grant interviews and action items for four local organizations in the 2026 funding cycle.
